what_worked: AI headcount-vs-monetization juxtaposition and growth-rate skepticism slide are genuinely decision-useful for investors.
fix_next: Clarify whether the core metric is MRR or 30-day revenue — the deck uses both interchangeably, undermining trust.
verdict: Strong investor-oriented story with clean visuals; metric ambiguity and minor data errors hold it back.
factual_error_detail: Slide 9: anonymous revenue share stated as 28.1% vs reference 26.525% (~1.6pp high); anonymous company count 130 vs reference 129.

evidence.insight: Slide 4 AI crowding insight, slide 7 domain-rating cliff as screening heuristic, slide 8 median-vs-mean growth critique, slide 10 survivorship bias in for-sale listings — four distinct non-obvious observations grounded in data.
evidence.narrative: Clear arc from concentration (3) → category illusion (4) → geography (5) → business model (6) → credibility (7) → growth skepticism (8) → data quality (9) → deal market (10) → synthesis (11) → actions (12). Conclusion ties threads coherently.
evidence.framing: Investor audience explicit throughout; slide 2 sets scope; slide 9 addresses missingness; slide 7 adds correlation caveat. However, the deck never resolves whether it analyzes MRR or 30-day revenue — slide 5 says '30-day revenue' while slides 3, 6, 7 say 'MRR,' creating confusion for a cold reader.
evidence.accuracy: Category counts match reference exactly. B2B median multiple 2.35x matches. Missing-field percentages for country (24.1%) and category (27.4%) match. Anonymous share overstated by ~1.6pp; anonymous count off by 1. Total MRR ($13.47M) vs reference total revenue ($15.6M) may reflect different fields but is never explained.
evidence.visual: Consistent dark/light palette with restrained color use. Slide 4 side-by-side bar charts effective. Slide 9 missingness chart well-designed. Slide 3 horizontal bars clearly labeled. Slide 7 cliff visualization supports headline. No decorative clutter.
evidence.ai_slop: Minimal. Slide 12 recommendations are concrete and data-grounded. No generic filler or decorative charts detected. Language is specific to dataset throughout.

change_reason: Reduced factual error count from 6 to 2 — preliminary incorrectly assumed MRR equals 30-day revenue, making category median comparisons invalid. Lowered bonus from 2 to 1; adjusted framing down 0.5 for unresolved MRR/revenue ambiguity; raised accuracy 0.5 since most verifiable claims check out.
